blocks.zh: 4.1 Dating Period Limitations (§§ 610.50–610.53) 4.1 有效日期限制（§§ 610.50–610.53）
blocks.en: 4.1 Dating Period Limitations (§§ 610.50–610.53)

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 有效期（Dating Period/Expiration Date）的法規意涵： 生物製品的有效期不是「製造商保證期」，而是「在規定儲存條件下可合理預期產品仍符合 Safety/Purity/Potency 標準的時間範圍」。這個標準由 BLA 中核准的穩定性數據決定。
blocks.en: Regulatory meaning of the dating period / expiration date: The dating period of a biological product is not a "manufacturer's guarantee period". It is the time frame during which, under the prescribed storage conditions, the product can reasonably be expected to continue to meet safety, purity and potency standards. It is determined by the stability data approved in the BLA.

blocks.zh: 有效期延長（Shelf Life Extension）： 若要延長已核准的有效期，必須提交 BLA 補充申請（通常 CBE-30 或 PAS，視影響程度），並附上支持更長有效期的額外穩定性數據。不能單方面延長。
blocks.en: Shelf life extension: To extend an approved dating period, you must submit a BLA supplement (usually a CBE-30 or PAS, depending on the level of impact) together with additional stability data supporting the longer dating period. A unilateral extension is not permitted.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 有效期就像保險契約的保障期限——在此期間，製造商「保證」產品符合 BLA 核准的所有標準。一旦超過有效期，「保證」失效，不可使用或配送。延長保障期需要重新提交新的「保險核保資料」（穩定性數據）。
blocks.en: The dating period is like the coverage period of an insurance contract: during this period the manufacturer "guarantees" that the product meets all the standards approved in the BLA. Once the expiration date has passed, the "guarantee" lapses and the product may not be used or distributed. Extending the coverage requires resubmitting new "underwriting data" (stability data).

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: ★ 生物製品的有效期通常遠比小分子藥品短（常見 6–24 個月，部分疫苗更短）。這對 CDMO 的批次規劃和庫存管理影響很大：充填後若有效期只有 12 個月，必須在此窗口內完成放行、配送、終端使用。
blocks.en: ★ The dating period of biological products is usually much shorter than that of small-molecule drugs (typically 6–24 months, and shorter for some vaccines). This has a major impact on CDMO batch planning and inventory management: if the dating period after filling is only 12 months, release, distribution and end use must all be completed within that window.

blocks.zh: ★ 超出有效期的生物製品必須銷毀或退回——不允許以任何形式銷售或使用（包括研究目的），除非有明確的監管豁免。
blocks.en: ★ Biological products past their expiration date must be destroyed or returned. They may not be sold or used in any form (including for research purposes) unless there is an explicit regulatory exemption.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一批 mAb 在充填後放行測試需要 4 週，有效期為充填後 18 個月——從 CDMO 的角度，如何計劃充填排程以確保客戶有足夠的使用時間？
blocks.en: A mAb batch needs 4 weeks of post-fill release testing and has a dating period of 18 months from filling. From the CDMO's perspective, how should the filling schedule be planned to ensure the customer has enough time to use the product?

blocks.zh: 如果 QC 實驗室發現一批已配送產品的留樣在有效期內出現降解，CDMO 和客戶各自的義務是什麼？
blocks.en: If the QC laboratory finds degradation in the retention samples of a batch that has already been distributed, while still within its dating period, what are the respective obligations of the CDMO and the customer?

blocks.zh: 4.2 Container Label Requirements (§ 610.60) 4.2 容器標籤要求（§ 610.60）
blocks.en: 4.2 Container Label Requirements (§ 610.60)

blocks.zh: 七個必備標籤元素的合規邏輯：
blocks.en: Compliance logic of the seven mandatory label elements:

blocks.zh: 產品名稱（Proper Name）： 必須是 BLA 核准的名稱，不是商品名（Brand Name）。例如：「bevacizumab」而非「Avastin」。
blocks.en: Product name (Proper Name): This must be the name approved in the BLA, not the brand name. For example, "bevacizumab" rather than "Avastin".

blocks.zh: 製造商資訊 + 許可證號： 注意是製造商（Manufacturer）的許可證號，不是配銷商。CDMO 充填的產品，標籤上的許可證號是 BLA 持有人（客戶）的，不是 CDMO 的。
blocks.en: Manufacturer information + license number: Note that this is the license number of the manufacturer, not the distributor. For a product filled by a CDMO, the license number on the label is that of the BLA holder (the customer), not the CDMO.

blocks.zh: 批號（Lot number）： 必須可追溯到完整的製造記錄。CDMO 的批號系統必須與客戶的批次追溯系統接軌。
blocks.en: Lot number: This must be traceable to the complete manufacturing records. The CDMO's lot numbering system must interface with the customer's batch traceability system.

blocks.zh: ★ 610.60(e) 視覺檢驗窗口要求：小瓶（vial）必須有足夠未被標籤覆蓋的區域，讓檢驗人員能看到液體。這影響 CDMO 的標籤設計和貼標機設定——圓形標籤若覆蓋整個瓶身會違反此要求。
blocks.en: ★ 610.60(e) visual inspection window requirement: a vial must have enough area not covered by the label to let inspectors see the liquid. This affects CDMO label design and labeler settings; a wrap-around label that covers the entire vial body would violate this requirement.

blocks.zh: ★「部分標籤（Partial label）」的情況在小型瓶（如 1 mL 或 2 mL 安瓶）常見——Lot number + Product name 必須在小瓶本身，完整資訊在外盒。這要求 CDMO 的標籤管理系統能確保小瓶和外盒標籤的配對正確。
blocks.en: ★ "Partial labels" are common on small containers (such as 1 mL or 2 mL ampoules): the lot number and product name must appear on the vial itself, with the full information on the outer carton. This requires the CDMO's label management system to ensure that vial and carton labels are matched correctly.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: Amaran 承接 2 mL 玻璃小瓶充填業務，瓶身標籤面積有限，無法印完整七個元素。根據 610.60(c)，可接受做法：(1) 小瓶標籤印：產品名稱 + 批號 + 製造商名稱 + 劑量；(2) 完整資訊（含效期、處方標誌、藥物指南聲明、地址）列於外盒標籤；(3) 確保小瓶有足夠視覺檢驗窗口（610.60(e)）。此設計必須在 BLA 中預先核准，CDMO 的標籤規格說明書（Label Specification）必須與 BLA 核准版本一致。
blocks.en: Amaran takes on a 2 mL glass vial filling project. The vial label area is limited and cannot carry all seven elements. Under 610.60(c), the acceptable approach is: (1) the vial label carries the product name, lot number, manufacturer name and dosage; (2) the full information (including expiration date, prescription legend, Medication Guide statement and address) appears on the carton label; (3) ensure the vial has an adequate visual inspection window (610.60(e)). This design must be pre-approved in the BLA, and the CDMO's Label Specification must be consistent with the BLA-approved version.

blocks.zh: 4.3 Package Label & Labeling Changes (§§ 610.61–610.68) 4.3 包裝標籤與標示變更（§§ 610.61–610.68）
blocks.en: 4.3 Package Label & Labeling Changes (§§ 610.61–610.68)

blocks.zh: 儲存溫度標示（610.65）的合規層次： 標籤上的儲存溫度（如「Store at 2°C–8°C」）必須與 BLA 中核准的儲存條件一致。CDMO 的儲存設施溫度管理、出貨冷鏈設計，都必須符合此標示的條件。如果標籤標示 2–8°C，但倉庫偶爾溫度超標，既是標籤誤導問題，也是 GMP 合規問題。
blocks.en: Compliance layers of storage temperature labeling (610.65): The storage temperature on the label (for example "Store at 2°C–8°C") must be consistent with the storage conditions approved in the BLA. The CDMO's storage facility temperature management and shipping cold chain design must all meet the conditions stated on the label. If the label says 2–8°C but the warehouse occasionally goes out of range, this is both a misleading-labeling issue and a GMP compliance issue.

blocks.zh: 標籤變更的法規路徑： 任何標籤變更（包括微小的字型調整、地址更新）都必須先經過 601.12 的變更分類評估，再決定走 PAS、CBE-30 或 Annual Report。CDMO 不可在未經客戶授權和 BLA 變更批准的情況下自行修改標籤。
blocks.en: Regulatory pathway for label changes: Any label change (including minor font adjustments and address updates) must first go through the change classification assessment under 601.12, which determines whether it goes through a PAS, a CBE-30 or the Annual Report. A CDMO may not modify a label on its own without customer authorization and approval of the BLA change.

blocks.zh: ★ 批號（Lot number）的可追溯性（610.63）是整個批次記錄體系的錨點——FDA 查廠時常從市售產品的批號反向追查所有製造記錄、測試記錄、原料記錄。CDMO 的批號系統必須確保這條追溯鏈完整無斷點。
blocks.en: ★ Lot number traceability (610.63) is the anchor of the entire batch record system. When FDA inspects a site, it often starts from the lot number of a marketed product and traces back through all manufacturing records, testing records and raw material records. The CDMO's lot numbering system must ensure that this traceability chain is complete, with no breaks.

blocks.zh: ★ 包裝標籤上的「Distributor」資訊（610.61）：如果客戶委由第三方配銷，包裝標籤上可能出現配銷商名稱——但製造商（持有 BLA 許可證）的名稱仍必須出現。CDMO 在設計標籤版型時需預留此欄位。
blocks.en: ★ "Distributor" information on the package label (610.61): if the customer uses a third party for distribution, the distributor's name may appear on the package label, but the name of the manufacturer (the license holder) must still appear. The CDMO needs to reserve this field when designing the label layout.

blocks.zh: 客戶 BLA 批准的儲存溫度是 2–8°C，但客戶現在希望在標籤上改為「不超過 25°C 可穩定 3 天」（方便運輸），這個標籤變更需要什麼法規路徑？
blocks.en: The storage temperature approved in the customer's BLA is 2–8°C, but the customer now wants the label to say "stable for 3 days at up to 25°C" (to facilitate transport). What regulatory pathway does this label change require?

blocks.zh: CDMO 的標籤檢驗程序（Label Reconciliation）如何確保 610.63 批號可追溯性的合規？
blocks.en: How does the CDMO's label inspection procedure (Label Reconciliation) ensure compliance with the lot number traceability requirement of 610.63?

blocks.zh: 4.4 Transfusion-Transmitted Infection Testing (§§ 610.39–610.48) — Blood Products Only 4.4 輸血傳播感染檢測（§§ 610.39–610.48）— 僅限血液製品
blocks.en: 4.4 Transfusion-Transmitted Infection Testing (§§ 610.39–610.48) — Blood Products Only

blocks.zh: Subpart E 的適用邊界： 輸血感染測試要求（§§ 610.39–610.48）只適用於「血液和血液成分（blood and blood components）」。對於無菌生物製品 CDMO（充填 mAb、疫苗、重組蛋白），這個 Subpart 不直接適用。
blocks.en: Scope of Subpart E: The transfusion-transmitted infection testing requirements (§§ 610.39–610.48) apply only to "blood and blood components". For a sterile biologics CDMO (filling mAbs, vaccines, recombinant proteins), this Subpart does not apply directly.

blocks.zh: 但是——某些以血液為原料的製品（如 Immune Globulin 免疫球蛋白、Albumin 白蛋白）涉及血漿來源，其源頭控制可能需要符合 Subpart E 精神，由 DS 製造商負責。
blocks.en: However, some products made from blood-derived starting materials (such as Immune Globulin and Albumin) involve plasma sourcing, and source controls for these may need to follow the spirit of Subpart E, which is the responsibility of the drug substance (DS) manufacturer.

blocks.zh: ★ 對於非血液產品的 CDMO，Subpart E 的主要價值是「了解但不需直接合規」。如果未來有機會承接血漿衍生產品（如 IVIG、Albumin）的充填，則需要深入研究 Parts 606、630、640 和 Subpart E 的整合要求。
blocks.en: ★ For a CDMO handling non-blood products, the main value of Subpart E is to "know it, but not need to comply with it directly". If there is a future opportunity to take on filling of plasma-derived products (such as IVIG and Albumin), the integrated requirements of Parts 606, 630 and 640 and Subpart E will need to be studied in depth.

blocks.zh: 某客戶希望 Amaran 承接靜脈注射免疫球蛋白（IVIG）的充填包裝——IVIG 是血漿衍生製品，在開始業務評估時，哪些 Parts 的合規要求需要優先了解？
blocks.en: A customer wants Amaran to take on filling and packaging of intravenous immune globulin (IVIG). IVIG is a plasma-derived product. When starting the business assessment, which Parts' compliance requirements should be understood first?

blocks.zh: Subpart E 要求的 NAT（核酸測試）和抗體測試，在血液安全管理上有何互補性？
blocks.en: In blood safety management, how do the NAT (nucleic acid testing) and antibody testing required by Subpart E complement each other?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 有效期（Dating Period）由 BLA 核准的穩定性數據決定，延長有效期需要提交 BLA 補充申請，不可單方面延長
blocks.en: The dating period is determined by the stability data approved in the BLA; extending it requires submitting a BLA supplement and cannot be done unilaterally

blocks.zh: 容器標籤七大必備元素（610.60）：產品名、製造商+許可證號、批號、效期、劑量、處方標誌、藥物指南聲明；空間不足時可用「部分標籤 + 完整外盒標籤」
blocks.en: Seven mandatory container label elements (610.60): product name, manufacturer + license number, lot number, expiration date, dosage, prescription legend, Medication Guide statement; when space is insufficient, a "partial label + full carton label" may be used

blocks.zh: 標籤視覺檢驗窗口（610.60e）：必須保留足夠未被標籤覆蓋的容器區域，允許液體外觀目視檢查
blocks.en: Visual inspection window on labels (610.60(e)): enough of the container area must remain uncovered by the label to allow visual inspection of the liquid

blocks.zh: 輸血感染測試（Subpart E §§ 610.39–610.48）只適用於血液成分，非血液生物製品 CDMO 不需直接合規
blocks.en: Transfusion-transmitted infection testing (Subpart E §§ 610.39–610.48) applies only to blood components; CDMOs for non-blood biologics do not need to comply directly
